items.title: AI Cloud Provider Lambda Taps Loans for Nvidia-Tied Chip Deal
items.summary: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia Corp., is selling a leveraged loan to finance a chip deal as the risky debt market becomes a new front in the borrowing…

items.title: World's biggest chipmaker TSMC's sales surge 45% amid buoyant AI demand
items.summary: TSMC makes chips for Big Tech customers like Nvidia and Google, so the firm's financial figures are closely watched as a sign of AI semiconductor demand.

items.title: U.S. oil price hits $80 as doubt grows Washington and Tehran will reach Strait of Hormuz deal
items.summary: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not come anytime soon.

items.title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa, guacamole on salmonella outbreak, intensifying food-safety fears
items.summary: Taylor Farms said on Sunday it was recalling prepared food items containing jalapenos from retailers, including Walmart, Kroger and Whole Foods in some states.

items.title: HHS moves to tighten oversight of food ingredients as safety concerns mount
items.summary: HHS moves to tighten oversight of food ingredients and define ultra-processed foods as food safety concerns raise questions about FDA visibility.

items.title: JPMorgan Leads $441 Million Debt Deal for AI Infrastructure Firm
items.summary: Global AI, a two-year-old tech firm, has raised $441 million in debt financing led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. to meet growing demand for artificial intelligence data centers.

items.title: Meta Releases AI Model You Can Use at Home
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta has released a scaled-down AI program consumers can download and use on a personal computer. It's called Muse Glimmer. Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
